Enabled Cache Components and Partial Prefetching in [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts:3). The navigation stays in the immediately rendered shell; [layout.tsx](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:8) streams the request details behind a loading fallback. [RequestMetadata](/workspace/components/request-metadata.tsx:4) now waits for the request before generating its ID, timestamp, and sample.

The production build passed and reports `/` as partially prerendered with dynamic content. Two requests to the production server returned different values for all three fields. No routes are opted out.
